title: Extract specific fields or characters from a file using cut
summary: Use the `cut` command to extract specific columns (fields) or character positions from a text file. This is useful for cleaning up data or getting just the part of a line you need.

steps.explain: Extract specific fields (columns) from a file. By default, fields are separated by tabs. Replace <FIELDS> with the field numbers you want (e.g., '2,6' for fields 2 and 6, or '2-' for field 2 to the end).

placeholders.name: FIELDS
placeholders.description: Field numbers to extract, e.g., '2,6' or '2-'

alternatives.explain: Extract characters by position instead of fields. Replace <CHARS> with the character range (e.g., '5-10').
Use a custom delimiter (like a comma or space) to split fields. Replace <DELIMITER> with your separator.

placeholders.name: DELIMITER
placeholders.description: The character separating fields, e.g., ',' or ' '
